items.title: Amazon's Black Friday Audible Deal Is Now Live: Pay $0.99 Per Month Plus Get $20 Credit
items.excerpt: Both Amazon Prime and non-Prime members, new and previous subscribers are eligible.
items.content_text: Black Friday lands on November 27 this year but plenty of deals are already going live now, including Amazon's annual Audible Black Friday promotion. Starting now and running through December 28, both Amazon Prime and non-Prime members can sign up for three months of Audible Standard for $0.99 per month. In addition to the discounted membership, you also get an extra $20 in Audible credit. This deal is valid for new and previous (currently expired) subscribers, however your mileage may vary (we noticed that some this deal doesn't show up for some account). Afterwards your subscription will convert to the standard $8.99/mo, but you can cancel the auto-renewal at any time. Audible Black Friday Deal: $0.99 Per Month + $20 in Audible Credit New and previous subscribers Amazon offers two Audible subscription tiers: Standard and Premium Plus. Standard is a lot less expensive - $8.95 per month compared to $14.95 per month. Standard also gets you access to nearly the same catalog of million plus audiobooks that Premium Plus does. Premium Plus does have an extra "Plus" catalog of about 150,000 books. The main difference, however, lies in the credits: Standard gets one free audiobook per month that you can read so long as you maintain your membership . Premium Plus gets you one free audiobook that you keep indefinitely. Unless you really want an audiobook to keep every month, then the Standard subscription is the better deal. Most of the popular audiobook series, including Dungeon Crawler Crawl, Hunger Games, The Stormlight Archive, and more, are available in the Standard collection. You'll save $72 on subscription fees per year not including this discount. Dungeon Crawler Carl audiobooks are on Audible IGN's Jacob Kienlen is a huge fan of the Dungeon Crawler Carl LitRPG series . He's written about many of the books and just recently the series' first ever graphic novel . The books are all currently available as audiobooks, all narrated by Jeff Hays, who is part of Soundbooth Theater. They also all happen to be free to listen to with an Audible membership. Catch up on the latest novel releases, audiobook style Audible is a subscription service that gives you access to over 1.1 million of the best audiobooks without ever having to purchase them. Several best-selling new and recent releases are available in an audiobook format and part of Audible's accessible library. Rebecca Yarros' The Empyrean Series romantasy novels have consistently hit the top of the New York Times' best seller list throughout all of 2025 and they're all available in audiobook format. Sunrise on the Reaping, the latest Hunger Games novel, is narrated by Jefferson White, who you may already know from Yellowstone where he played Jimmy Hudstrom. The audiobook has a listening time of about 12 hours and 48 minutes. If you're looking for something fast-paced and fun, you can also check out Matt Dinniman's popular Dungeon Crawler Carl series. It's currently the bestselling audiobook on Audible right now thanks to excellent narration from Jeff Hays. This new deal will get you the first three DCC audiobooks for only $0.99 . Ever prolific Stephen King released the Never Flinch crime novel in 2025. It's available as a nearly 15-hour long audiobook narrated by veteran Jessie Mueller. If you're a fan of fantasy , check out Brandon Sanderson's Wind and Truth , book five of the popular The Stormlight Archive series. It was released in December of 2024 and runs an epic 63 hours long. items.title: Amazon Reveals Free Uber Eats Delivery for Prime Members, Plus $20 Off Your First Two Orders
items.content_text: Amazon Prime members can now get $0 delivery fees on orders over $25. Amazon revealed in a November 5 press release that this benefit is now available to use, and subscribers are eligible for $20 off their first two orders for the next two weeks. This new service replaces the Prime GrubHub+ benefit, which has officially expired as of today . If you're already a member, all you need to do is search 'Uber Eats' on Amazon to find restaurants and start placing an order. Alternatively, you can go straight to the official Uber Eats page to check out what's available. For those who don't already have an Amazon Prime membership, you can sign up for a free trial to get the benefit. This likely won't get you the extra $20 off, as the Amazon press release states an "eligible Prime membership" is needed to to take advantage of the promotion. If you're already planning on picking up a subscription ahead of Black Friday season , however, it's still probably worth it to make full use of those Prime benefits . The press release doesn't explain why Amazon made the shift from GrubHub+ to Uber Eats, only that this will be the partnership moving forward. Amazon Prime Vice President Jamil Ghani commented how the deal fits into the service, saying: “This is what Prime is all about: unlimited free, fast delivery on a wide selection of products, big savings, fantastic entertainment, and now even more value on restaurant delivery with Uber Eats, all in a single membership.” For those with an Amazon Prime membership already, this is basically free food money. You can use this promotion to get a discount on dinner for your family or go wild and order a stack of KFC Doomsday Chicken Sandwiches for yourself. The bonus $20 off credit will only last from now until November 19.

items.title: Animated John Wick Prequel Film in the Works Starring Keanu Reeves
items.excerpt: Keanu Reeves is returning as John Wick in an animated film that aims to tell the assassin’s story before the tragic events of the first movie.
items.content_text: Keanu Reeves is returning as John Wick in an animated film that aims to tell the assassin’s story before the tragic events of the first movie. The animated flick will be produced by the same team that produced the John Wick movies , comprised of Thunder Road’s Basil Iwanyk and Erica Lee, 87Eleven Entertainment’s Chad Stahelski, and, of course, Keanu Reeves. Point Grey will join the group to produce, as well. Reeves is also set to reprise his role as the ‘Baba Yaga.’ As told by Lionsgate, this movie will “go back in time to tell the story of John Wick before the first film, as he completes the Impossible Task in order to free himself from his obligation to the High Table and earn the right to be with the love of his life, Helen.” (It’ll be nice to see John Wick being happy, for once.) Shannon Tindle, an Emmy Award-winning director, writer, and producer known for works like Ultraman: Rising and Kubo and the Two Strings is set to direct. Screenwriting duo Ryan and Kaz Firpo are onboard to write the film; the two are known for Marvel’s Eternals . This is the latest news we’ve gotten from this highly-anticipated project after it was first announced last year. Adam Fogelson, motion picture chair at Lionsgate, gave fans a little something to chew on during its announcement, saying, “In both animation and the world of ‘John Wick,’ the possibilities are endless. And there is no ‘John Wick’ story fans are clamoring for more than the ‘Impossible Task.’ Shannon’s take on that story is an incredible one, and we are beyond excited to see what John Wick can do in animation.” The specific animation house responsible for bringing John Wick’s action-packed, assassin-filled world to life has not yet been officially announced. For now, it’s anyone’s guess as to what it will eventually look like, but it’s certainly exciting news while we wait for John Wick 5. Yes, a fifth movie installment is going to happen, despite the fourth movie appearing to end on a perfect note. The film was first revealed in April 2025, with Fogelson most recently saying that director “Chad [Stahelski] and Keanu have an idea that they think can be really exciting.” Previously, Stahelski said a script was in active development, though the actual story seemed to be eluding him and fellow writer Mike Finch. “I’m not going to lie to you, it’s a bit of a conundrum. Me and Mike Finch — the writer on 4 who’s also writing 5 — we’ve got a pretty good story that I think is cool. Once we have a 50-page book, and if we’re feeling it, we’ll sit with Keanu and shape this thing. Look, everybody seems to want it. It’s a matter of whether we crack it. We’re actively working on it. It’s just … is it going to be satisfying?” he said in an interview with The Hollywood Reporter. These aren’t the only John Wick projects in the works; Reeves is also portraying the titular character in a video game from Saber Interactive, coming to PlayStation 5, Xbox X|S, and PC at an as-yet unreleased date. An official blurb described what players can expect from the title, saying, “Saber's design will be faithful to the unique style and signature elements of the series, including a distinct gun fu combat system, jaw-dropping camerawork, immersive driving experiences, and a variety of memorable environments, all crafted to make players feel like they are in a John Wick movie, playing the role of John Wick himself."
items.title_en: Animated John Wick Prequel Film in the Works Starring Keanu Reeves

items.title: Spectrum Is Offering Free Internet Upgrades So People Can Download GTA 6 Faster
items.excerpt: Spectrum customers can get a free internet upgrade this month to download GTA 6 faster.
items.content_text: Spectrum customers can get a free internet upgrade this month to download GTA 6 faster. The company announced earlier this week that it would be a free "Gig Speed Lift" from November 9 to November 30 for existing customers. This will allow players the opportunity to download the game within 30 minutes. So, if you're planning on buying the game on day one or later in November, this will be a huge time saver. Or, if you just want to watch your pre-load complete incredibly quickly, this is also an option. You can click here to learn more about how to activate this offer if you're a Spectrum user. Pre-loading for GTA 6 begins on November 10 , and it will be an absolute beast of a game when it comes to download size. Rockstar has confirmed that the game is 212 GBs, which is nearly a quarter the size of the average PS5 (not counting the required space for the OS and other mandatory elements on the console). Given that fans are anticipating a pretty massive open-world with lots to see and do, the size makes sense. As a result, fans will want to take full advantage of the nine-day pre-load window or hop on this Spectrum deal so they can play as soon as possible. We're officially just two weeks away from the GTA 6's launch. Rockstar released 39 new screenshots from the game earlier today , showing off Vice City, Jason and Lucia in action, and a whole bunch of crime. The screenshots also revealed that rapper Kodak Black would be in the game as an NPC , which has fueled speculation that other musical artists would be in the game. The likes of Dr Dre, Phil Collins, and others have all been prominently featured in-game in other GTA titles, so it's not a stretch to imagine some celebrities in a modern-day Vice City. It's unclear what else Rockstar has up its sleeve as we get closer to launch, as it released what appears to be the final trailer back in October. Some fans are expecting to hear about PS5 Pro upgrades prior to release, but beyond that, we appear to be at the end of this long marketing road.

The drone ships from a local US warehouse, so there are no additional import fees and delivery is within a week. The DJI Neo 2 is one of the latest models that is FCC approved and can be legally purchased. Save 33% Off the DJI Neo 2 4K Drone Quadcopter Camera The DJI Neo 2 was released in November of 2025. It's a petite drone that weighs in at 151 grams, or about 5.3 ounces. That means this quadcopter doesn't have to be registered with the FAA. It's so light that even if you use the heavier extended battery, you're probably still under the 249 gram cutoff. If you do want to register, it's only $5 and is valid for 3 years. The Neo 2 measures 5.8" x 6.7" x 1.6" and packs away easily because of its compact size. It's designed to be used outdoors and is rated to withstand up to Level 5 winds (up to 24mph), although it's good practice to not tests its limits on a constant basis. Brushless motors allow the Neo 2 4K to travel at a zippy horizontal top speed of up to 27mph. The Fly More Combo includes accessories you actually really need I wouldn't recommend buying a DJI drone by itself because the add-ons - especially the batteries - will cost you a pretty penny. Because batteries are a mission critical component (very bad news if the battery fails while the drone is in mid-air), most people recommend you stick with first party batteries for maximum reliability and longevity, and I agree with that sentiment. Therefore, you really should be going with the Fly More Combo , which includes a physical RC-N3 remote control, a digital transceiver that enables DJI's O4 (OcuSync 4) for greatly enhanced transmission range, and three OEM batteries with a 3-slot charger. The stock battery will give you up to 18 minutes of runtime in ideal conditions, although 12-15 minutes is a more accurate real-world estimate. Affordable and beginner-friendly gateway to the world of aerial photography Because this is a camera designed for beginners, it has intelligent features to assist you in piloting the drone properly. Automated functions include one-tap takeoff and landing, GPS Return to Base (RTB), and stable hovering. The rotors have integrated propeller guards so you don't have to worry about chipped blades every time you screw up a landing. The built-in 4K camera records directly onto the 49GB onboard storage (there's no option to expand the capacity with memory cards). Shake-free video footage is very possible thanks to a combination of built-in 2-axis mechanical gimbal and electronic image stabilization. Framing and composing your shot is straightforward with an array of preset video techniques like Helix, Dronie, Rocket, and Boomerang. items.title: Bill Skarsgård Explains Why Starring in Hideo Kojima’s Physint Is a ‘Big Deal’ for Him
items.excerpt: Skarsgård opened up about Physint in a November 5 episode of Josh Horowitz’s Happy Sad Confused podcast, where he revealed that he’s a massive fan of the Metal Gear series and shared a conversation he had with Kojima regarding his love for cinema.
items.content_text: In September 2026, Hollywood’s resident horror icon Bill Skarsgård was confirmed to play the lead role in Hideo Kojima’s highly anticipated action-espionage project Physint . This game marks a long-awaited return to form from Kojima as fans pine for another Metal Gear-style experience. And while much about it is still unknown, we got just a smidge more information about the project thanks to its leading man, Bill Skarsgård. Skarsgård opened up about the game in a November 5 episode of Josh Horowitz’s Happy Sad Confused podcast, where he revealed that he’s a massive fan of the Metal Gear series and shared a conversation he had with Kojima regarding his love for cinema. “That’s a big deal for me,” he said. “Specifically, the Metal Gear Solid games. I played every single [one], at least the ones on [console] platform. Starting from the one on PlayStation 1 all the way to the last one. I was very enamored by [Kojima], the mythology and the universes he creates, but also the sort of mystique and allure about him, as well. “I was really into it growing up. He is an auteur, but he’s a video game auteur. He’s fluent in filmmaking, and film, and cinema. I think at this point, I remember at one point way back, 20 years ago, there was talk of a Metal Gear solid movie. ‘Is Hideo going to direct it? Of course, I can’t wait to see him transition into film.’ I asked him, ‘Would you ever do a film?’ and he’s like, ‘No.’ At this point, what he’s doing is inventing a new medium. It is film. It’s eight hours worth of narrative, but it’s also an entire universe that you play. It truly is, quite literally, worldbuilding. Now, with technology, we’re getting closer and closer to something that's photorealistic and interactive when you play it. He’s a pioneer, and he keeps going out to untreaded waters.” Skarsgård went on to confirm that he is providing performance capture for the game, something he already has experience with thanks to his role in Marvel’s Eternals and his extensive past working with mocap studio Goodbye Kansas (known for Alan Wake 2, God of War, Cyberpunk 2077 and many more). This is the latest glimpse into the game we’ve gotten since the cast was revealed in September, which also includes Charlee Fraser, Don Lee, and Minami Hamabe. And in early October, Kojima discussed Physint in a podcast, saying he wants the project to “evoke the roots of Metal Gear Solid games” but be a “new interactive experience with a different kind of spy action,” as told by IGN’s Ryan McCaffrey . Most notably, Physint recently changed hands from Sony to Xbox ; in a bombshell statement, Kojima said the game faced cancellation from the PlayStation parent company, but luckily, Microsoft stepped in to keep it alive. Sources told Bloomberg the project "missed deadlines and was on track to be well over budget despite being years away from release," suggesting that PlayStation’s seemingly sudden decision to drop the game was a direct result of these issues. For now, fans can look forward to the Death Stranding anime , as well as watch out for more from Kojima’s upcoming horror game, OD Knock , starring Hunter Schafer and Sophia Lillis. News on the Metal Gear movie continues to be sparse, with its last big update happening earlier this year when Final Destination: Bloodlines duo Zach Lipovsky and Adam B. Stein were brought on to direct . Image Credit: Jamie McCarthy/Getty Images for BAFTA
items.title_en: Bill Skarsgård Explains Why Starring in Hideo Kojima’s Physint Is a ‘Big Deal’ for Him

items.title: Dr. Doom Is Taking Over Dave and Buster’s in Lead-up to Avengers: Doomsday
items.excerpt: Dr. Doom’s latest target is entertainment chain Dave and Buster’s, which has fully submitted to the Marvel villain for an expansive Avengers: Doomsday campaign.
items.content_text: Dr. Doom’s latest target is entertainment chain Dave and Buster’s, which has fully submitted to the Marvel villain for an expansive Avengers: Doomsday campaign. Starting on November 16, Dave & Buster’s is becoming Doom & Buster’s. Select locations are already rolling out ‘Doomsday Zones,’ entire sections of the arcade dedicated to the Avengers takeover. Enter the Dr. Doom archway and you’ll find a collection of Marvel games and activities in addition to new D&B drinks and prizes. "When one of the biggest movies of the year is coming, you don't put up a poster. You bend the knee," said Jeremy Tucker, chief marketing officer at Dave & Buster's. "We gave Doom our name. We gave him the floor. We gave him the bar… All shall play." As one of the leading arcade chains, the big tie-in is games. On Dave & Buster's floors, fans can already find a new selection of Marvel-themed activities: Doom & Buster’s activities: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion Avengers: Roller Race & Battle Human Crane Mystery Crane Thor's Hammer Strike The Arena Smash N Win Avengers Themed Photo Booth Cosmic Invasion is the big headliner here. The game dropped on PC and consoles last December, and through the D&B campaign, is now getting the full arcade cabinet treatment. Like the fully released version, the arcade edition will support up to four players. We’re pretty big fans of the tag-team beat-em up, saying it "has the juice" in our 7/10 review , which knocks off some points for a limited hero gallery. Thankfully, the game has released plenty of new content in the past year. A new Doom-themed DLC, 'The Siege of Castle Doom,' is launching on November 10, and will presumably be included in the in-store activations. New prizes vary across locations. The crane games are packed with their own range of Marvel-specific collectibles, including some vaguely described "new inflatables." Doomsday Zones will also feature a fully stocked Avengers Funko pusher, while kiosks offer new Avengers-themed prizes like Collectible Power Cards. Throughout the campaign, ‘DOOMHOUR’ will strike at random times, offering customers double tickets on any green swipe games. D&B Rewards members will get a 24-hour heads up about the DOOMHOUR, while the rest of us peasants will simply have to wait for the alarm to blare. Registered members will also get access to new Rewards Challenges throughout the campaign. Of course, Dave and Buster’s bars are also now serving a spread of Doom-themed drinks. For the alcohol-inclined, D&B offers the Doomsday's Dominion, Multiversal Mule, and Fantastic Flight. New mocktails include Panther's Potion and Captain’s Punch. Marvel has been collaborating with everything from KFC to the MLB in the lead-up to Avengers: Doomsday, releasing in theaters on December 18. Dave & Buster’s, however, appears particularly willing to commit to the bit, which is exactly what Disney execs are looking for. "Rather than creating a traditional promotion, they transformed their entire business into an immersive celebration of Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday," said Lylle Breier, EVP of Partnerships, Promotions and Events at The Walt Disney Studios. "The result is a bold, fan-first experience that extends the story beyond the theater and into the real world in a way only Dave & Buster's could."

items.content_text: Curry Barker, famous for his hit horror movie Obsession, is keen on bringing his terrifying tastes to the world of Indiana Jones if the opportunity ever arises. Barker shared his vision for an especially grisly take on Indy’s adventures during a conversation with Gold Derby after the outlet brought up similar remarks made by Cooper Tomlinson, Barker’s longtime collaborator who co-wrote, produced, and starred in Obsession as Ian, Bear’s best friend. "I would want to do a really f**ked up, rated-R version of [ Indiana Jones ],” Barker said. “I want to do a crazy adventure movie. That's something that Cooper and I have talked about, because we feel like we've never seen something like that; we've only ever seen the family-friendly version. “But what happens if two regular guys, or one regular guy, goes on a journey that turns crazy? Literally pushing the boundaries of that genre would be fun for me." As previously mentioned, Tomlinson feels a similar way, hoping to bring back the action-adventure films that defined cinema through the '80s and '90s. "I'd love to bring back the adventure epic like Raiders of the Lost Ark ," he told the outlet. "What really worked with Obsession was making something that was honest and grounded in reality; obviously we can all suspend disbelief and enjoy all the crazy action stuff that isn't real. But when it comes to the characters and story, it should be more grounded and honest. That's how we're going to get those kinds of action classics back." Speaking of action-adventure movies that defined the '90s, Michael Johnston (who played Bear in Obsession) has been cast in the next Mummy movie, which will also feature the return of Brendan Fraser and Rachel Weisz. Also speaking with Golden Derby , he described the contrast between filming a small-budget indie horror movie like Obsession and a grand, big-budget picture like The Mummy: Book of the Dead as “really different.” "These productions are like a well-oiled machine; we do a scene many, many times from many, many different angles, which is nice because it gives us the opportunity to work things out. That takes the pressure off in a way," he said. "But there's also a lot more waiting around on those sets than on indie films. With something like Obsession, you only have a couple chances to get something done, and you're also helping everyone else out behind the scenes. I'm not doing that on The Mummy; I'm sitting back in my chair and enjoying the catering. But getting to work with Brendan and Rachel is great, and [directors] Matt Bettinelli-Olpin and Tyler Gillett are the most lovely guys." The Mummy: Book of the Dead is scheduled to release on October 15, 2027. Barker’s next movie, a horror-comedy called Anything But Ghosts , is also releasing next year in May.
items.title_en: Obsession Director Curry Barker Wants to Make a ‘F**ked Up, R-Rated’ Indiana Jones Movie

items.title: The Odyssey Is Returning to IMAX Theaters in December Ahead of Awards Season
items.excerpt: The Odyssey is returning to theaters in December for one last hoorah before awards season goes into full swing.
items.content_text: The Odyssey is returning to theaters in December for one last hoorah before awards season goes into full swing. Universal has announced that Christopher Nolan's R-rated epic will return to theaters on December 11 in over 1,000 cinemas across the United States and Canada. The film will be coming back to IMAX screens, including ones that support the 70MM IMAX format it was designed for. This is presumably part of a larger campaign to get The Odyssey some awards buzz ahead of the Oscars, and probably earn some extra pocket change for the studio. The Odyssey has already made $1.8 billion at the box office to become the highest-grossing R-rated film in history . It seems hard to imagine this re-release getting it over the hump for $2 billion, as Dune Part 3 will take over premium format screens on December 18. Avengers: Doomsday will also take up as much attention for movie lovers, if not more. It's unclear if The Odyssey will continue to play on regular screens after those two movies are released, or if this is a limited one-week run. The Odyssey is a favorite for many of the big prestigious awards, with many expecting a Best Picture nomination, Best Actor for Matt Damon, Best Director for Christopher Nolan, and many more. Whether it scores all of the nominations it's expected to get remains to be seen. It'll also be interesting to see what awards it could win, as Nolan's last film, Oppenheimer, cleaned house at the Oscars in 2023. It's rare for a filmmaker to win big twice in a row, though not unheard of. Alejandro González Iñárritu won Best Director back-to-back years in 2014 and 2015 for Birdman and The Revenant, respectively. Nevertheless, it'll be a busy time at the movie theater in December with the return of The Odyssey and some of the year's heaviest hitters with Dune and Avengers. For those who aren't interested in venturing out into the cold to see Nolan's latest film again, The Odyssey is also coming to home video later this month .

items.title: G2 Esports Parts Ways With Head Coach Luka 'Perkz' Perković After His 'Tweet Bomb' Sparks Backlash
items.excerpt: G2 Esports has parted ways with its head coach, Luka "Perkz" Perković, following divisive comments he made in a lengthy post on Twitter/X.
items.content_text: G2 Esports has parted ways with its head coach and retired League of Legends player Luka "Perkz" Perković following divisive comments he made in a lengthy post on Twitter/X. The 2,676-word-long tweet was published on November 4, 2026. Perković described it as his “first and last honest post in [the] last decade,” where he could “address some things honestly.” He explained that he’d written the statement to clarify his stance on certain topics “so that, at the very least, you can hate me for what I really stand for, and then that's completely fine by me.” In the post, which he jokingly called a “tweet bomb,” Perković said he is not a fan of and does not endorse the Tate brothers in any way; claimed that “doesn’t really do politics” and has never “ever voted once” in his life; said he is not a fan of either Donald Trump or Kamala Harris; said he is a devout Catholic; denied being a “Putin fanboy” or being on the side of Russia in the war on Ukraine; and shared his stance on abortion, comparing it to “murder.” “I don’t really do politics, nor have I even ever voted once in my life. I do have opinions, and I wish I was more educated on the topic, but the truth is I’m not, so I stay away from it,” he wrote. “There are some things I stand for, very simple things in life, but the only thing that is unshakeable for me, how it’s so widely accepted in public, is abortion. I cannot comprehend how people do not understand that is a muder, as life is created at conception. That is one view I will die by and never change.” Perković also addressed his relationship with retired League of Legends pro and former G2 CEO Carlos "ocelote" Rodríguez Santiago, who stepped down from the company in 2022 after sharing a video of himself at a party with Andrew Tate. “Me standing up for Carlos publicly when he was being cancelled has nothing to [do] with all the things I’m all accused of supporting. Trafficking? Misogyny? Nazism? War? Are you okay?” Perković said of the matter. “Carlos believed in me when nobody else did. I did not have a close relationship with my family when I was 16, including my parents, [who] I was not too close with, either. …Carlos and I have gone both completely different ways. He is his own person and I’m completely my own. In the end Carlos’ ego is something that put an end to his esports career, which was f**king insane. So there is a lesson to be learned in there, as well. We have a lot of different views on life.” Perhaps the biggest takeaway from Perković’s post was his stance on abortion. This particular remark was a main talking point among fans and fellow players on social media, sparking a massive wave of backlash against him. G2 Esports addressed the situation in a public post mere hours later, where they confirmed that they have parted ways with Perković due to his tweet. Their full statement is as follows: “Last night, like many of you, we saw the statement shared by the Head Coach of one of our teams. G2 is a diverse and international organization with different people from all around the world. While the world is complex and not everyone agrees on everything, some of the statements made last night do not align with G2's stance and values. We have fans with different cultures and personal opinions, and it is of the utmost importance to us as an organisation that we respect and uphold this diversity when representing G2. We acknowledge that this statement hurt many of our fans, and we want to apologize for it. “As a result, we have decided to terminate our collaboration with the individual. We will now focus on rebuilding our staff and roster for the next season and ask for your patience, as we will not be able to communicate any changes until free agency officially opens. - Alban Dechelotte, CEO of G2.” Perković has since published one other tweet — a Bible verse from Luke 6:22. “Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man’s sake,” he wrote. This post, too, has received backlash from users. Perković has not posted anything else on his account at the time of writing.
items.title_en: G2 Esports Parts Ways With Head Coach Luka 'Perkz' Perković After His 'Tweet Bomb' Sparks Backlash

items.title: There's a 'Fifty-Fifty' Chance Godzilla Minus Zero Director Takashi Yamazaki Would Make a Godzilla Threequel
items.excerpt: The ending of Godzilla Minus Zero leaves just enough room for a continuation of the story filmmaker Takashi Yamazaki has crafted, but the writer/director says he's split on whether or not he'd want to come back to it.
items.content_text: Godzilla Minus Zero writer/director Takashi Yamazaki told The Hollywood Reporter that he's "fifty-fifty" on whether or not he'd come back to make a third Godzilla film. Extremely minor Godzilla Minus Zero spoilers ahead! "I’m quite satisfied and happy with the current ending we have," Yakazaki said when asked about the film's ambiguous ending that leaves just enough room for a continuation of the story. "It entrusts the interpretation to the audience in terms of how they want to receive it and what they want to walk out of theaters with. That being said, if Godzilla Minus Zero is my last Godzilla film, that would make me a bit sad. I do have other films lined up, starting with Grandgear and a few others, but at some point in my career, I would love to revisit Godzilla and see how we can expand this world." Grandgear was announced in 2024 as Yamazaki's first major Hollywood studio movie, with Sony Pictures, and his first English-language feature film. It's currently slated for a February 18, 2028 release . Starring Sam Nivola (The White Lotus Season 3), Nico Parker (The Last of Us, the live-action How to Train Your Dragon), and Paul Giamatti (it's Paul Giamatti...), Grandgear is a live-action sci-fi mecha movie, something Yamazaki also told THR was "something I’ve always wanted to do." Yamazaki is writing and directing, and Bad Robot is producing. But first, Godzilla Minus Zero comes out in U.S. theaters this weekend, a mere three years after Godzilla Minus One became a box-office sensation in 2023 on a reportedly tiny $10–15 million budget and a lean 35-person VFX team, with Yamazaki overseeing. It went on to win the Oscar for Best Visual Effects, marking the first time a Japanese film took home the award, and did it with the tiniest budget of any category winner in more than a decade . Yamazaki told IGN that, when writing Godzilla Minus Zero, he had to set aside the need to try and one-up everything he had accomplished with Godzilla Minus One. “I think it's very dangerous to create a movie with that type of mindset because you're going to risk diluting what makes the movie great in the first place," he said. "So those are the wrong reasons to make a movie and it ends up becoming an antagonist in your moviemaking process.” Godzilla Minus Zero is both the first R-rated Godzilla movie and the first Japanese film to be specifically shot for IMAX screens. It's also very loud ! We said it was Good in our review , calling out its "satisfying and visually amazing scenes of giant-monster destruction." But back to the potential of a third Godzilla movie. Turning these films into a trilogy raises a critical question: What would it be called, after the naming convention has already counted down from Minus One to Minus Zero? I have a pitch: Godzilla Plus One that, of course, introduces another new kaiju. Toho, call me!
items.title_en: There's a 'Fifty-Fifty' Chance Godzilla Minus Zero Director Takashi Yamazaki Would Make a Godzilla Threequel

items.title: It's Official: Marvel Has Finally Undone the Controversial Spider-Man - One More Day Storyline
items.excerpt: The day Spider-Man fans have been waiting 20 years for has finally arrived - Marvel Comics has undone the controversial Spider-Man: One More Day storyline.
items.content_text: Full spoilers follow for Captain America #16 and The Avengers #1! The day Spider-Man fans feared would never come has finally arrived. Marvel Comics has officially started the process of undoing 2007's Spider-Man: One More Day. The hugely controversial storyline that saw Peter Parker and Mary Jane Watson sacrifice their marriage to save Aunt May is being undone after nearly 20 years of continued controversy. How did Marvel finally undo One More Day? And what does this mean for Spidey going forward? Let's break down what we know right now. Step 1: Mephisto Loses Hell There have certainly been signs recently that Marvel was finally preparing to undo One More Day . In particular, the ending of Avengers: Armageddon teased an imminent showdown between Mephisto and Spider-Man. Armageddon writer Chip Zdarsky has wasted no time in following up on that thread in his other Marvel books. The first step in reversing One More Day came in Captain America #16. The series has recently been telling a story parallel to the events of Armageddon, with a comatose Steve Rogers having his soul dragged to Hell by Doctor Doom (who's been trapped there ever since the end of 2025's One World Under Doom). Doom enlisted Cap in a fight to depose Mephisto and install a new, more benevolent ruler of Hell. True to form, Doom is always looking out for number one, and the end result is that he himself is now the master of Hell. However, he has no desire to be the warden of an otherworldly prison. Doom frees all of Hell's souls, wishing that only those who wish to follow him remain. He even releases the soul of his lover, Valeria. As for Mephisto himself, he flees his domain and makes a beeline for the safety of the mortal world. This marks a major status quo shift for the supernatural corner of the Marvel Universe. The most immediate effect from Doom's ascension is that all deals made with the previous ruler of Hell are now null and void. That includes a bargain struck between Mephisto and a certain wallcrawling superhero. Step 2: Spider-Man Remembers His Bargain That Captain America twist immediately carries over into the pages of Zdarsky and Marco Checchetto's relaunched Avengers comic. With Mephisto deposed, an army of angelic warriors descend upon New York City and begin attacking everyone who ever made a deal with Mephisto, be it for eternal youth or whatever else. The angels seem to have a specific target - a girl named Paige whose mother and grandfather made a bargain with the demon lord. Paige is given a mysterious talking book and told to track down Spider-Man. When she does, Paige tells Spidey that only he can help her, because he too made a deal with the devil. Initially, Spidey has no idea what Paige is referring to. But when Paige tells him that he made a deal to save the life of someone he loved, Peter begins to remember that terrible day. On some level, he admits, he's always known what he did to save his beloved aunt. That may be all for naught now, as the angels begin targeting Aunt May herself at the F.E.A.S.T. shelter. If she's only alive now because of Mephisto, then they may feel her life is forfeit. It's up to Spidey and the newly reformed Avengers to save her life once again. Step 3: Profit? Naturally, this raises a lot of questions about the immediate future of the Spider-Man franchise. The most obvious question is what it all means for Peter and MJ's relationship. Apart from a very brief rekindling of their romance in 2018 (before the infamous Paul Rabin stepped in), Peter and MJ have been broken up since the end of One More Day in 2007. Thanks to Mephisto's meddling, their marriage now never existed in the first place. Will Peter and MJ remember what they sacrificed, and will this cause them to get back together? All of this is part of Zdarsky's larger interconnected plans for the Marvel Universe. The writer told The Beat , "It’s the joy of Marvel. It’s the joy of the interconnectedness of everything that you can spin things off into different series, and storylines become a new thing as a result of working with the character for a while. Doom is so fun to write. Like, I pitched stuff in the room last week about Doom for like two years from now. Because I’m just like, ‘Oh, wouldn’t this be cool?’ So yeah, Mephisto is, it’s the devil. Writing the devil is a lot of fun." We suspect Peter and May are going to have to sit down and have a long overdue conversation about what he sacrificed for her sake. We'll see exactly how the current Avengers storyline plays out. Marvel is already teasing some big developments ahead in issue #2 , as it seems Mephisto will be assembling his own Sinister Six that includes Sabretooth, Carnage, the Abomination, Kraven the Hunter, and Green Goblin. Ultimately, though, it may be up to The Amazing Spider-Man writer Joe Kelly to decide how the dissolution of the One More Day bargain impacts Peter's personal life. Currently, Peter is dealing with other problems on the Aunt May front , as her estranged son Cormac has literally stolen her memories of Peter and cut Peter out of her life. But once that's resolved, we suspect Peter and May are going to have to sit down and have a long overdue conversation about what he sacrificed for her sake. One of the many reasons One More Day has proven so controversial over the years is that many fans have argued that May would be horrified to learn Peter chose her over his wife and unborn daughter. Peter and MJ may finally face a reckoning for that choice, and they'll certainly have to decide how to move forward now that the truth is finally laid bare. Do you think Peter and MJ will finally get back together now that One More Day has been undone? Vote in our poll and let us know your thoughts in the comments below. For more, check out our full review of The Avengers #1 . Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .

items.content_text: There are many reasons why an electric scooter might be a better fit for you than an electric bike. They're lighter, more compact, and usually less expensive. items.title: BioWare's Final Years Were Filmed and Will Be Revealed in a New Documentary
items.excerpt: The last two years of BioWare's life were filmed and will be shown in a new documentary about the game studio.
items.content_text: The last two years of BioWare's life were filmed and will be shown in a new documentary about the game studio. The documentary, titled Massive Effect: The BioWare Story, will show the studio's journey over the last few years. While it's unclear if this will include new footage of the canceled Mass Effect game, it is a rare peek behind the curtain and likely a raw one, given how the story ends. Industry veteran Geoff Keighley revealed that he was interviewed for the film earlier this year, and confirmed that it will be released sometime in 2027. The project is being produced by Shane Fennessey and Adam Scorgie for Canada‘s Super Channel, as BioWare was primarily a Canadian studio. It's unclear if it will also be made available online for those outside of Canada. The documentary will feature exclusive interviews and insights from BioWare talent, such as Mass Effect game director Casey Hudson, Jennifer Hale (voice actress for the female variant of Commander Shepard), and many more. It should be an interesting watch whenever it is released. “When the production team asked for our blessing to tell the BioWare story, we were honoured and genuinely moved,” said BioWare co-founders Dr. Ray Muzyka and Dr. Greg Zeschuk. “BioWare was never just about the logo or the building. It was about deeply emotionally engaging stories and characters, brought to life by the amazingly talented people on our dev teams, and our excellent production and distribution partners who helped us bring those stories successfully to all corners of the planet, and our passionate fans who defended those worlds, championed them and carried them forward. We’re proud this film honours those who made it all possible. The best stories never really end. They live on in our memories and wait for someone to pick them up again.” BioWare was shut down last month , much to the shock of the wider industry and fans alike. The studio had been struggling for a while; its last three games were misfires, and the next Mass Effect game was expected to still be years away. As a result, EA reportedly decided to place its bets on a new Star Wars Battlefront game from DICE and Respawn instead of continuing to fund a new Mass Effect game. A trailer for Mass Effect 5 , which was apparently called Mass Effect Universe, did find its way online, painting a better picture of what fans could've expected from the canceled game. Some fans have held out hope that the Mass Effect IP could be acquired by another company, but as of right now, it doesn't seem like that's in the cards.
